# PlowWow

> plowwow.com — Commercial snow removal and liquid de-icing, Lower Mainland BC. 24/7. Call 604-761-1518.

PlowWow delivers 24/7 snow removal, salting, and liquid de-icing for residential, strata, and commercial properties across Greater Vancouver BC.

## Services

- Snow Plowing
- Liquid De-Icing & Brine Application
- Salting & Sanding
- Strata Snow Removal Contracts
- Commercial Parking Lot Snow Removal
- Emergency Snow Response

## Service Area

Vancouver, Burnaby, Surrey, Richmond, Coquitlam, North Vancouver, Langley, Abbotsford, New Westminster, Delta, Maple Ridge, Chilliwack, Mission
